svg.title: Fay Hattı · daily sliding-tile map puzzle
svg.desc: Banner for Fay Hattı: a parchment map of Anatolia made of sliding tiles, a river from a spring and a road from a caravanserai meeting at a village while the bottom row shifts in a small quake; the game name, the tagline and the line Claude Game Arena, made for GitHub Game Off 2026.
